name: confessions
description: Anonymous confessions with numbered cards, optional threads, anonymous replies, cooldowns, and hash-based moderator bans.

configFields.label: Confession Channel
configFields.description: Channel where anonymous confessions are posted.

configFields.label: Moderation Log
configFields.description: Optional channel that records confession moderation actions without author identities.

configFields.label: Auto-Thread
configFields.description: Create a discussion thread under each confession for anonymous replies.

configFields.label: Allow Image URLs
configFields.description: Allow an optional image URL on confessions and replies.

configFields.label: Cooldown (minutes)
configFields.description: Minimum gap between confessions from the same author.

endUserDataStatement: Stores a per-guild random salt, irreversible SHA-256 author hashes used only for bans and cooldowns, confession text and optional image URLs, message and thread IDs, and counters. No raw user IDs or reversible identity keys are stored; authors cannot be identified or direct-messaged.
